input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: Searches for MFN-style language ("most favoured nation", "no less favourable", "favorable/favourable", "best price", "lowest", "other customers", "discount", "third party") return nothing of the kind, and the only plausible homes for such language are silent: the Fees section (sec-11, p0084) is a bare obligation to pay the Fee Schedule amounts, the maintenance pricing provisions (sec-10) simply cross-refer to the Fee Schedule, and General Matters (sec-20) covers only time of the essence and notices. Sparkling is therefore under no obligation to extend Garman terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and there is no obligation to match third-party offers. That matches the preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer), so no redline is warranted. Note for completeness that the agreement also contains no MFN running in our favour, which we could raise as a commercial ask but is not required by this rule.
